regulations.heading: Citation
regulations.text: These Regulations may be cited as the Forest (Amendments) Regulations, 2017 and shall be read as one with the Forest Regulations, 2004 hereinafter referred to as the 'principal Regulations'.

regulations.heading: Amendment of the Schedules
regulations.text: The Eighth and Fourteenth Schedules to the principal Regulations are hereby revoked and replaced for them with the following.

signed.office: Minister for Natural Resources and Tourism

notes: In the event the mode of disposal is by tender or public auction, the fees set below shall be the baseline price.
In the event the mode of disposal is by public auction, the auction price shall apply to all persons who have valid sale agreement with the Government.

items.name: Pulpwood

fees.description: Fees for pulpwood trees shall be charged per cubic metre and shall not be used for any other purpose; when used for any other purpose other than pulp production, shall be charged as in Part B Item 1 above

items.note: With reference to the Forest Plantations' Management Plans in operation for the current 2014/2015 - 2018/2019 Strategic Plan, trees raised and managed to cater for pulpwood raw material have not attained the requisite rotation age. TFS, with utmost intent to fathom public interest and the State's motive to nurture industrial revolution, has been supplying pulpwood raw material from the stock primarily raised to yield saw logs (irrespective of diameter classification) as a remedial practice that necessitates designation of a complimentary Government Notice (GN).
